newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates steady at 3.00-4.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates steady at 3.00-4.00 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar were steady on Sunday in a 3.00-4.00 percent range despite bank subscription in last week's CD issue, dealers said.
Bankers attributed excess liquidity in the last few weeks to a flood of maturing CDs returning to the market along with indications of higher bank deposits and lower subscription in new CD issues.
Rates fluctuated between 3.50 percent and 6.00 percent last week.
